run_cycle_diffusion_pipeline: run the CycleDiffusionPipeline to transform an image from a source prompt to a target prompt
encode_prompt_with_clip: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method
prepare_latents_from_image: prepare noisy latents from an input image using prepare_latents for img2img generation
compute_posterior_sample: compute the posterior sample of source latents using the posterior_sample helper function
compute_noise_for_scheduler: compute noise from predicted noise and latents using the compute_noise helper function
